Package index

Consistency tests

Check the numerical consistency of summary statistics

GRIM

Test reported means or percentages for numerical consistency with reported sample sizes

grim()
The GRIM test (granularity-related inconsistency of means)
grim_explain() experimental
Explain a GRIM test step by step
grim_map()
GRIM-test many cases at once
grim_map_seq()
GRIM-test values around the reported ones
grim_map_total_n()
GRIM-test with hypothetical group sizes
grim_plot_grid()
Visualize GRIM test results
grim_plot_line() experimental
Visualize the means that GRIM admits
grim_plot_rates() experimental
Compare GRIM inconsistency rates to random means
grim_grid() experimental
GRIM results on a grid of sample sizes and means
grim_values() grim_closest() experimental
Achievable means behind a reported one
grim_exp_incon() grim_total()
Possible GRIM inconsistencies
grim_granularity()
Granularity of non-continuous scales
grim_binomial() experimental
Poisson binomial test for the rate of GRIM consistency
grim_binomial_power() experimental
Power of the GRIM binomial test

GRIMMER

Test reported means and standard deviations for numerical consistency with reported sample sizes

grimmer()
The GRIMMER test (granularity-related inconsistency of means mapped to error repeats)
grimmer_explain() experimental
Explain a GRIMMER test step by step
grimmer_map()
GRIMMER-test many cases at once
grimmer_map_seq()
GRIMMER-test values around the reported ones
grimmer_map_total_n()
GRIMMER-test with hypothetical group sizes
grimmer_plot_line() experimental
Visualize the standard deviations that GRIMMER admits
grimmer_values() grimmer_closest() experimental
Achievable means and SDs behind a reported pair

DEBIT

Test reported means and standard deviations of binary data for numerical consistency with reported sample sizes

debit()
The DEBIT (descriptive binary) test
debit_explain() experimental
Explain a DEBIT test step by step
debit_map()
DEBIT-test many cases at once
debit_map_seq()
DEBIT-test values around the reported ones
debit_map_total_n()
DEBIT-test with hypothetical group sizes
debit_plot()
Visualize DEBIT results
debit_plot_line() experimental
Visualize the standard deviations that DEBIT admits
debit_values() debit_closest() experimental
Achievable means and SDs of binary data
sd_binary_groups() sd_binary_0_n() sd_binary_1_n() sd_binary_mean_n() superseded
Standard deviation of binary data

Percentages and sums

Test reported percentages against their counts, and subgroup sizes against their totals

percentage_of() experimental
Is a reported percentage consistent with its count?
percentage_of_map() experimental
Test many reported percentages against their counts
percentage_of_map_seq() experimental
Test percentages against their counts with values around the reported ones
add_up_to() experimental
Do reported counts add up to their total?
add_up_to_map() experimental
Test whether reported counts add up to their totals

Duplicate detection

Blunt functions to tentatively discover and count duplicate numeric values; interpret results with care

duplicate_count()
Count duplicate values
duplicate_count_colpair()
Count duplicate values by column pair
duplicate_tally()
Count duplicates at each observation

Summarize and explain results

Summarize, explain, and document the output of scrutiny’s tests

audit()
Summarize scrutiny objects
audit-special
Classes of sequence and total-n mapper output
explain_map() experimental
Explain mapper results row by row
explain_print() experimental
Print the explanations of mapper results
scrutiny_meta() experimental
Read the settings a mapper recorded on its output

Developer tools

Helpers for implementing error detection techniques. Unlike the functions above, these may change in minor releases, with a NEWS entry.

Function factories

Easily create new mapper functions for consistency tests

function_map()
Create new *_map() functions
function_map_seq()
Create new *_map_seq() functions
function_map_total_n()
Create new *_map_total_n() functions
reverse_map_seq()
Reconstruct the input of a sequence mapper
reverse_map_total_n()
Reconstruct the input of a total-n mapper
absorb_key_args() superseded
Rename key columns according to the key arguments

Counting decimal places

decimal_places()
Count decimal places

Sequence generation

seq_disperse() seq_disperse_df()
Sequences dispersed around a value
disperse() disperse2() disperse_total()
Vary hypothetical group sizes

Consistency test helpers

Call these helpers inside of your own functions that implement consistency tests at various levels

check_mapper_input_colnames() superseded
Check that a mapper's input has the right column names
manage_helper_col() superseded
Manage a helper column
audit_cols_minimal()
Compute minimal audit() summaries

Data frame predicates

Test for mapper function output

is_map_df() is_map_basic_df() is_map_seq_df() is_map_total_n_df()
Is an object the output of a mapper function?

Data wrangling

Automate formatting tasks with a special relevance to error detection

split_by_parens()
Split columns by parentheses, brackets, braces, or similar
before_parens() inside_parens()
Extract substrings from before and inside parentheses
row_to_colnames()
Turn row values into column names
